remarks: UNDER CONSTRUCTION | TRIOMPHE ESTATES, BEAUMONT  Modern design meets thoughtful functionality in this impressive home, offering an estimated 2218 sq. ft. based on builder plans.  The main floor features an open-to-below concept, a bedroom and full bathroom, plus a beautifully planned kitchen with an extended kitchen layout and separate spice kitchen, ideal for everyday living and entertaining.  Upstairs offers 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, creating a comfortable family retreat. A side entrance to the basement adds flexibility for potential future development, subject to applicable approvals and requirements.  Thoughtful design, a functional floor plan, and quality finishes come together to create a home designed for modern living.
